feedback.title: Yaya muke yi?
feedback.description: Ra'ayinka yana taimaka mana mu inganta — kuma za a iya nuna kyawawan sharhi a shafinmu na yanar gizo.
feedback.returningDescription: Ka dawo sau da yawa — za mu so ka ba mu ƙimar taurari cikin sauri da duk wani tunaninka. Yana taimakawa ƙwarai.
feedback.lovedPlaceholder: Ɓangaren da yaronka (ko kai) ya fi so…
feedback.improvePlaceholder: Duk abin da ya ɓata maka rai ko kake so a canza (don ƙungiyarmu kaɗai)
feedback.privateNote: Ƙungiyarmu kaɗai ke ganin wannan — ba a taɓa nuna shi a bainar jama'a ba.
feedback.consentMarketing: Kuna iya nuna abin da na so a matsayin shaida a shafinku na yanar gizo da kafofin sada zumunta.
feedback.consentNamed: Kuna iya amfani da sunana na farko tare da shi.
feedback.sendFailed: Ba a iya aika ra'ayi ba

homeScreen.title: Mataki na ƙarshe — sanya shi a taɓawa 1 kawai
homeScreen.body: Ajiye MyPhonicsBooks a allon gidanka. Gobe, ba yaronka wayar — zai taɓa alamar ya fara karatu. Babu shiga. Babu rubutu.
homeScreen.iosStep2: Gungura ƙasa → taɓa "Ƙara zuwa Allon Gida"
homeScreen.iosStep3: Taɓa Ƙara a saman dama. Shi ke nan!
homeScreen.otherDevice: Buɗe wannan shafi a Chrome (Android) ko Safari (iPhone) a wayarka don saka manhajar a allon gidanka.

nudges.title: Sannu! Ga sabbin abubuwa
nudges.empty: Ka ga komai. Za mu sanar da kai idan akwai wani sabon abu.
